hooks.command: bash -c 'COMMON_DIR=$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; MAIN_ROOT=$(cd "$COMMON_DIR/.." && pwd); if [ ! -f local.properties ] && [ -f "$MAIN_ROOT/local.properties" ]; then cp "$MAIN_ROOT/local.properties" local.properties && echo "copied local.properties from $MAIN_ROOT"; fi'
